credits.title: Number One
credits.overview: In the context of China's urbanization, a young man faces existential difficulties and decides to rewrite his life.

credits.title: Love Never Dies
credits.overview: An urban movie that integrates love, action, fantasy, suspense, and black humor. A traffic jam reveals the fate of a group of people: a drug dealer, Rashomon (Wu Zhenyu), Clockwork (Chen Zhipeng) and Yixiu (Wu Junyu).
